situationsChanged: STM-0143: Explore candidates' examples of guest service, shift handovers and teamwork with operational departments.
STM-0127: Discuss an observed gap in agreed shift attendance or handover quality and its effect on department coverage.
constraints: Use only supplied shift arrangements and performance evidence.
Do not prescribe hotel safety procedures.
Use planned B2 questioning and explanation; managerial responsibility does not determine CEFR.

jobKnowledge.title: Operational recruitment
jobKnowledge.text: The department head may need coverage during a supplied busy period. Interview questions connect the candidate's experience and availability to the actual role, without assuming that all hotel staff work identical shifts.

jobKnowledge.title: Handover impact
jobKnowledge.text: Incomplete handover information can leave the next team uncertain about outstanding guest requests. A performance conversation examines the supplied example, hears the employee's explanation and explores workable support.

content.register: Respectful and evidence-led; probe specific examples without personal accusations.
content.differenceStatement: Hotel HR connects staffing to service periods, roster coverage and continuity between operational shifts. Interview evidence centres on guest-facing teamwork; performance discussion may address handovers affecting the next team. These priorities differ from software HR's project collaboration and hybrid coordination.
